name: ticket-to-plan
description: Feature → ticket → ralphex plan → ralphex code → revmux review → acceptance → merge: composes a user-gated tech-lead ticket, drives ralphex's plan mode with a real review loop, runs the plan through ralphex tasks-only, hands the branch to revmux for a supervised multi-agent review, does the final acceptance by hand, and lands it through a PR with a squash-merge.
